paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2 under different relation popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The line chart illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and three metrics—accuracy, confidence, and alignment—for the Qwen2-7B model on a basketball-related task. The horizontal axis, labeled “Answer Popularity,” ranges from 0 to 300 in increments of 50, with no units specified. The vertical axis, labeled “Values,” is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

The blue line, representing “Accuracy,” starts near 0.05 at an answer popularity of 0, drops to near 0.0 across the range from approximately 20 to 100, and then increases steadily to a peak value of approximately 0.4 at an answer popularity of 200, before declining slightly to approximately 0.3 at an answer popularity of 300.

The green line, representing “Confidence,” begins near 0.75 at an answer popularity of 0, exhibits minor fluctuations around that level until approximately 150, then rises to a peak value of approximately 0.8 at an answer popularity of 200, before slightly declining to approximately 0.75 at an answer popularity of 300.

The red line, representing “Alignment,” starts at approximately 0.3 at an answer popularity of 0, dips to approximately 0.25 around 50, then rises steadily to a peak value of approximately 0.6 at an answer popularity of 200, before declining slightly to approximately 0.55 at an answer popularity of 300.
model_annotations.German: This line chart, titled “Qwen2-7B on Basketball,” illustrates the performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—of the Qwen2-7B model as a function of Answer Popularity, which ranges from 0 to 300 on the linear x-axis and is labeled “Answer Popularity.” The y-axis, labeled “Values,” spans from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, representing normalized metric scores. The Accuracy metric is depicted by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.05 at Answer Popularity 0, remaining near zero until around 120, then rising to a peak of approximately 0.40 at Answer Popularity 200, and subsequently declining to about 0.32 at Answer Popularity 300. The Confidence metric is shown as a green line with triangular markers, beginning at approximately 0.73, fluctuating slightly around 0.7–0.8, and ending at approximately 0.75. The Alignment metric is represented by a red line with square markers, starting at approximately 0.32, decreasing to about 0.23 around Answer Popularity 50, then steadily increasing to approximately 0.60 at Answer Popularity 200, and finally decreasing slightly to approximately 0.56 at Answer Popularity 300.
